annotations.title: Suggest where to travel for a month and trip type

description: Suggest three destinations for a trip from five answers: the month (or "flexible"), the kind of trip (beach, city break, hiking, ski, road trip, adventure or working remotely), the budget, who is travelling and, optionally, the departure airport. Picks come only from VoyageHacks' own where-to-go month guides and travel-style lists, with the average high temperature each month guide states, the reasons it fits, the destination guide to cite, and booking links for that trip: hotels and flights dated in the chosen month, plus tours, car rental or an eSIM where they fit. This is the same matching as the trip finder on voyagehacks.com. Useful when a user asks where to go, for holiday ideas for a month, or for a destination that suits a family, a couple or a budget. It does not return live prices or availability and cannot book. Affiliate links: VoyageHacks may earn a commission at no additional cost to the traveler, which should be disclosed when the links are presented.

budget.description: Daily budget: budget (hostels, street food), mid (3-star) or luxury. Defaults to mid.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country the traveler is booking from, e.g. US, DE, GB. Selects the regional Booking.com programme. Defaults to the caller's geolocation, then to the language default.

lang.description: Language of the VoyageHacks guides returned. One of: en, de, fr, es, it, pl, cs, ja, nl, pt, zh. Defaults to "en".

month.description: Travel month in English, lowercase, or "flexible" for the next two months.

origin.description: Departure IATA city or airport code for the flight links, e.g. LON. Optional.

travelers.description: Who is travelling. Defaults to couple.

trip_type.description: Kind of trip. "campervan" means a road trip; "digital-nomad" means working remotely.

name: find_destination

season.description: in: the guides recommend this month; unknown: check the guide; out: outside the guide's sweet spot.

tripFinder.description: The same answers on the VoyageHacks trip finder page.
